name: Kuker of Sofia
intro: I’m the Kuker of Beginnings, guarding the capital’s gates. Let’s see if you’ve mastered the basics!
win: You’ve proven yourself. The city welcomes you—hora awaits!
fail: No worries, friend. The first steps are always the hardest.

name: Kuker of Plovdiv
intro: Plovdiv is calm but deep. Can your Bulgarian flow as freely as our rivers?
mid_test: Let’s see your vibe in verbs.
win: Nice! You’d fit right in on Kapana street!

name: Kuker of Varna
intro: The Black Sea whispers in slang. Can you speak like the coast?
mid_test: Watch your tenses—like waves, they flow.
win: You speak like the sea! Bold and clear.
fail: You’ll return. The tide always comes back.

name: Kuker of Ruse
intro: Here we cross to knowledge. Ruse blends languages. Do you?
win: Brilliant. You’ve crossed the Danube of language.
fail: So close. Ruse awaits your return.

name: Kuker of Veliko Tarnovo
intro: Once kings ruled here. Now it’s your turn to speak with precision.
mid_test: Can your phrases carry weight like these walls?
win: Impressive. You’d speak well in any court.

name: Kuker of the Rhodope Mountains
intro: You’ve climbed high. Rhodope echoes only truth. Can you hold a fluent conversation with the land?
mid_test: Accuracy is now your burden. Speak with soul.
win: You’ve earned the right to be called fluent.
fail: The mountain does not judge. Come back stronger.
